messages:
maria: Quick kickoff for an enterprise one-pager + launch assets. Need: clear security & SLA callouts, a short careful benchmark sentence, deploy-mode micro-compare, inbound routing rules, and a webinar CTA. Can people add must-haves? :pray:

sam: Ill take hero + two-line subhead. Suggest a platform-forward hero and a small security micro-CTA. Keep hero tight for header.

leo: Benchmark constraints: keep it high-level and cautious. Include: median token latency on a mid-sized RLHF workload (no absolutes), Dedicated concurrency at a high level, and fallback behavior when a pinned model is absent.

jamie: Field needs inbound form fields: company size, compliance (HIPAA / SOC2 / FedRAMP), desired deploy mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), and KMS/HSM required? If Private selected route to AE queue "AE-Private" and SE "SE-Infra". Tag leads: enterprise-security + deploy-mode-interest.

anna: Sales asks the CTA be a 15-min "prod-fit" call (low friction) and webinar framed as a technical deep-dive + live Q&A. Include calendar link and option to request an on-prem demo.

kelsey: Add a short pre-webinar survey: expected peak TPS, avg tokens/request, compliance constraints. Use answers to tailor the demo.

maria: Draft hero (platform): "Inference that scales predictably  predictable throughput, intelligent fallbacks, workload-aware cost controls." Security micro-CTA: "Regulated-ready: VPC, KMS, audit logs." Subline: "Tune routing, caching, and quantization per workload to meet latency SLOs." CTAs: [Request 15-min prod-fit] [Join Benchmark Deep-Dive].

sam: One-pager layout idea: top hero, left column bullets (SLA, Private, Optimize), center 3-column micro-chart Hosted/Dedicated/Private (time-to-value / predictability / data control), right column QR/form link and CTAs. Tiny tech note below.

leo: Tech note (2 lines) for PDF: "Serving runtime: GPU-optimized kernels, continuous batching, KV cache. Smart routing: policy-based model selection with automatic fallback to compatible variants."

maria: Draft benchmark line (careful): "Internal tests found Dedicated pools sustaining hundreds of req/min with low median token latencies on mid-sized LLMs; hosted autoscaling produced comparable tail latency in single-tenant scenarios. Workload-aware prefix caching reduced token spend in internal test sets by ~20%+." Mark for legal review.

jamie: Routing rule suggestion: if company_size > 1000 AND compliance in (HIPAA, FedRAMP) => AE-high-priority + SE assigned; else standard nurture. Push tags via webhook to SFDC/Hubspot.

anna: Email subject A/B for blast: A) "New: predictable LLM inference with enterprise SLAs" B) "Benchmark recap: lower unit cost, preserved latency". A/B both. Email CTA: PDF + prod-fit calendar + tagged intake form.

sam: Webinar plan (35m): 5m positioning, 10m benchmark narrative + short Dedicated demo, 10m privacy/SLA deep-dive (KMS, audit logs, routing policies), 5-10m customer lightning cases, 5-10m live Q&A focused on benchmarks & rollouts.

kelsey: We'll gate webinar with pre-survey; route high-compliance responses to a private demo waitlist.

ops-bot: deploy-note: preview branch created marketing/enterprise-prod-fit-1712001234  staging preview https://staging.redwood.ai/enterprise-prod-fit-preview :rocket:

maria: Final microcopy ask: include explicit fallback line on the one-pager: "If a pinned model is unavailable, requests will be served from the nearest compatible variant to preserve availability." Agree?

sam: Agreed. Ill finalize hero + PDF visual and share mocks by EOD Wednesday.

leo: I'll run the benchmark phrasing through legal today and flag edits inline.

jamie: I'll draft the form mapping and AE routing webhooks once fields are final.

maria: Thanks all  I'll consolidate and upload the final one-pager + webinar pre-survey when design exports are ready. :clap:
